import pytest
from freebusy import free_slots

WEEK = ("mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri")
FULL_WEEK = ("mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri", "sat", "sun")


# ============================================================================
# Basic functionality tests
# ============================================================================


def test_single_attendee_single_day():
    """Test with one attendee on a single day."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-17:00"]}}
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-06T08:00Z", "2025-06-06T18:00Z", 30)
    assert result == [("2025-06-06T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T17:00:00Z")]


def test_single_attendee_multiple_days():
    """Test with one attendee across multiple days."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {d: ["09:00-17:00"] for d in WEEK}}
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-02T00:00Z", "2025-06-07T00:00Z", 30)
    # Mon-Fri are working days
    assert result == [
        ("2025-06-02T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-02T17:00:00Z"),
        ("2025-06-03T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-03T17:00:00Z"),
        ("2025-06-04T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-04T17:00:00Z"),
        ("2025-06-05T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-05T17:00:00Z"),
        ("2025-06-06T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T17:00:00Z"),
    ]


def test_no_working_hours():
    """Test when attendee has no working hours in the window."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {"mon": ["09:00-17:00"]}}
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-02T00:00Z", "2025-06-03T00:00Z", 30)
    # June 2 is Monday 09:00-17:00
    assert result == [("2025-06-02T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-02T17:00:00Z")]


def test_no_free_slots():
    """Test when no time is free."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-10:00"]}}
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-06T10:00Z", "2025-06-06T12:00Z", 30)
    assert result == []


# ============================================================================
# Multiple attendees
# ============================================================================


def test_two_attendees_overlap():
    """Test two attendees with overlapping working hours."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {d: ["09:00-17:00"] for d in WEEK}}
    bob = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {d: ["10:00-18:00"] for d in WEEK}}
    result = free_slots(
        [alice, bob], "2025-06-02T00:00Z", "2025-06-03T00:00Z", 30
    )
    # Only 10:00-17:00 on Monday when both are working
    assert result == [("2025-06-02T10:00:00Z", "2025-06-02T17:00:00Z")]


def test_two_attendees_no_overlap():
    """Test two attendees with no overlapping working hours."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {d: ["09:00-12:00"] for d in WEEK}}
    bob = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {d: ["13:00-17:00"] for d in WEEK}}
    result = free_slots(
        [alice, bob], "2025-06-02T00:00Z", "2025-06-03T00:00Z", 30
    )
    assert result == []


def test_multiple_attendees():
    """Test with more than two attendees."""
    attendees = [
        {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {d: ["09:00-18:00"] for d in WEEK}},
        {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {d: ["10:00-17:00"] for d in WEEK}},
        {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {d: ["11:00-16:00"] for d in WEEK}},
    ]
    result = free_slots(attendees, "2025-06-02T00:00Z", "2025-06-03T00:00Z", 30)
    # All three working: 11:00-16:00
    assert result == [("2025-06-02T11:00:00Z", "2025-06-02T16:00:00Z")]


# ============================================================================
# Timezone handling
# ============================================================================


def test_timezone_different_zones():
    """Test two attendees in different time zones."""
    ny = {"tz": "America/New_York", "hours": {d: ["09:00-17:00"] for d in WEEK}}
    berlin = {"tz": "Europe/Berlin", "hours": {d: ["09:00-17:00"] for d in WEEK}}
    result = free_slots([ny, berlin], "2025-06-02T00:00Z", "2025-06-03T00:00Z", 30)
    # NY is UTC-4, Berlin is UTC+2 in June
    # NY working: 13:00-21:00 UTC
    # Berlin working: 07:00-15:00 UTC
    # Overlap: 13:00-15:00 UTC
    assert result == [("2025-06-02T13:00:00Z", "2025-06-02T15:00:00Z")]


def test_timezone_tokyo():
    """Test with Asia/Tokyo timezone."""
    tokyo = {"tz": "Asia/Tokyo", "hours": {"mon": ["09:00-18:00"]}}
    result = free_slots([tokyo], "2025-06-01T00:00Z", "2025-06-03T00:00Z", 30)
    # June 2 is Monday, Tokyo is UTC+9
    # 09:00-18:00 JST = 00:00-09:00 UTC
    assert result == [("2025-06-02T00:00:00Z", "2025-06-02T09:00:00Z")]


def test_timezone_with_positive_offset():
    """Test timestamp with positive UTC offset."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {"mon": ["09:00-17:00"]}}
    # Timestamp with +05:30 offset (like IST)
    result = free_slots(
        [alice], "2025-06-02T03:30Z", "2025-06-02T12:30Z", 30
    )
    # Both timestamps are Monday in UTC
    # Working hours are 09:00-17:00 UTC
    assert result == [("2025-06-02T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-02T12:30:00Z")]


def test_timezone_with_negative_offset():
    """Test timestamp with negative UTC offset."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {"mon": ["09:00-17:00"]}}
    # Timestamp with -04:00 offset
    result = free_slots(
        [alice], "2025-06-02T13:00-04:00", "2025-06-02T22:00-04:00", 30
    )
    # 13:00-04:00 = 17:00 UTC, 22:00-04:00 = 02:00+1 UTC
    # So window is 17:00 UTC to 02:00 UTC next day
    # On Monday only 09:00-17:00 is working
    assert result == []


# ============================================================================
# Busy periods
# ============================================================================


def test_busy_period_simple():
    """Test with a simple busy period."""
    alice = {
        "tz": "UTC",
        "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-17:00"]},
        "busy": [["2025-06-06T12:00Z", "2025-06-06T14:00Z"]],
    }
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-06T08:00Z", "2025-06-06T18:00Z", 30)
    # Working 09:00-17:00, busy 12:00-14:00
    # Free: 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-17:00
    assert result == [
        ("2025-06-06T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T12:00:00Z"),
        ("2025-06-06T14:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T17:00:00Z"),
    ]


def test_busy_period_no_free_time():
    """Test when busy period covers all working hours."""
    alice = {
        "tz": "UTC",
        "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-17:00"]},
        "busy": [["2025-06-06T09:00Z", "2025-06-06T17:00Z"]],
    }
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-06T08:00Z", "2025-06-06T18:00Z", 30)
    assert result == []


def test_multiple_busy_periods():
    """Test with multiple busy periods."""
    alice = {
        "tz": "UTC",
        "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-17:00"]},
        "busy": [
            ["2025-06-06T10:00Z", "2025-06-06T11:00Z"],
            ["2025-06-06T13:00Z", "2025-06-06T14:00Z"],
            ["2025-06-06T15:00Z", "2025-06-06T16:00Z"],
        ],
    }
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-06T08:00Z", "2025-06-06T18:00Z", 30)
    # Free: 09:00-10:00 (60 min), 11:00-13:00 (120 min), 14:00-15:00 (60 min), 16:00-17:00 (60 min)
    assert result == [
        ("2025-06-06T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T10:00:00Z"),
        ("2025-06-06T11:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T13:00:00Z"),
        ("2025-06-06T14:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T15:00:00Z"),
        ("2025-06-06T16:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T17:00:00Z"),
    ]


def test_busy_period_overlapping():
    """Test with overlapping busy periods."""
    alice = {
        "tz": "UTC",
        "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-17:00"]},
        "busy": [
            ["2025-06-06T10:00Z", "2025-06-06T12:00Z"],
            ["2025-06-06T11:00Z", "2025-06-06T13:00Z"],
        ],
    }
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-06T08:00Z", "2025-06-06T18:00Z", 30)
    # Overlapping busy periods merge to 10:00-13:00
    assert result == [
        ("2025-06-06T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T10:00:00Z"),
        ("2025-06-06T13:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T17:00:00Z"),
    ]


def test_busy_period_touching():
    """Test with touching busy periods."""
    alice = {
        "tz": "UTC",
        "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-17:00"]},
        "busy": [
            ["2025-06-06T10:00Z", "2025-06-06T12:00Z"],
            ["2025-06-06T12:00Z", "2025-06-06T14:00Z"],
        ],
    }
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-06T08:00Z", "2025-06-06T18:00Z", 30)
    # Touching periods merge to 10:00-14:00
    assert result == [
        ("2025-06-06T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T10:00:00Z"),
        ("2025-06-06T14:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T17:00:00Z"),
    ]


def test_busy_period_outside_working_hours():
    """Test when busy period is outside working hours."""
    alice = {
        "tz": "UTC",
        "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-17:00"]},
        "busy": [["2025-06-06T18:00Z", "2025-06-06T20:00Z"]],
    }
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-06T08:00Z", "2025-06-06T21:00Z", 30)
    # Busy is outside working hours, so full working hours are free
    assert result == [("2025-06-06T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T17:00:00Z")]


def test_busy_period_extends_outside_window():
    """Test when busy period extends outside the search window."""
    alice = {
        "tz": "UTC",
        "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-17:00"]},
        "busy": [["2025-06-06T08:00Z", "2025-06-06T12:00Z"]],
    }
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-06T10:00Z", "2025-06-06T18:00Z", 30)
    # Window starts at 10:00 but busy goes until 12:00
    assert result == [("2025-06-06T12:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T17:00:00Z")]


# ============================================================================
# min_minutes filtering
# ============================================================================


def test_min_minutes_30():
    """Test filtering by min_minutes = 30."""
    alice = {
        "tz": "UTC",
        "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-17:00"]},
        "busy": [
            ["2025-06-06T10:00Z", "2025-06-06T10:15Z"],
            ["2025-06-06T11:00Z", "2025-06-06T12:30Z"],
        ],
    }
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-06T08:00Z", "2025-06-06T18:00Z", 30)
    # Free: 09:00-10:00 (60 min), 10:15-11:00 (45 min), 12:30-17:00 (270 min)
    # Filtered: >= 30 min
    assert result == [
        ("2025-06-06T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T10:00:00Z"),
        ("2025-06-06T10:15:00Z", "2025-06-06T11:00:00Z"),
        ("2025-06-06T12:30:00Z", "2025-06-06T17:00:00Z"),
    ]


def test_min_minutes_60():
    """Test filtering by min_minutes = 60."""
    alice = {
        "tz": "UTC",
        "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-17:00"]},
        "busy": [
            ["2025-06-06T10:00Z", "2025-06-06T10:30Z"],
            ["2025-06-06T11:00Z", "2025-06-06T12:30Z"],
        ],
    }
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-06T08:00Z", "2025-06-06T18:00Z", 60)
    # Free: 09:00-10:00 (60 min), 10:30-11:00 (30 min), 12:30-17:00 (270 min)
    # Filtered: >= 60 min
    assert result == [
        ("2025-06-06T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T10:00:00Z"),
        ("2025-06-06T12:30:00Z", "2025-06-06T17:00:00Z"),
    ]


def test_min_minutes_all_filtered():
    """Test when all slots are filtered out by min_minutes."""
    alice = {
        "tz": "UTC",
        "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-17:00"]},
        "busy": [
            ["2025-06-06T09:30Z", "2025-06-06T10:00Z"],
            ["2025-06-06T10:30Z", "2025-06-06T11:00Z"],
        ],
    }
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-06T08:00Z", "2025-06-06T18:00Z", 60)
    # Free: 09:00-09:30 (30 min), 10:00-10:30 (30 min), 11:00-17:00 (360 min)
    # Only 11:00-17:00 is >= 60 min
    assert result == [("2025-06-06T11:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T17:00:00Z")]


# ============================================================================
# Working hours formats
# ============================================================================


def test_working_hours_overnight_simple():
    """Test overnight working hours (end < start)."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {"fri": ["22:00-06:00"]}}
    # Friday 22:00 UTC to Saturday 06:00 UTC
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-06T20:00Z", "2025-06-07T08:00Z", 30)
    assert result == [("2025-06-06T22:00:00Z", "2025-06-07T06:00:00Z")]


def test_working_hours_ending_at_24_00():
    """Test working hours ending at 24:00."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-24:00"]}}
    # Friday 09:00 UTC to Saturday 00:00 UTC
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-06T08:00Z", "2025-06-07T01:00Z", 30)
    # 24:00 means midnight at the end of the day
    assert result == [("2025-06-06T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-07T00:00:00Z")]


def test_working_hours_multiple_entries_same_day():
    """Test multiple working-hours entries on the same day."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-12:00", "13:00-17:00"]}}
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-06T08:00Z", "2025-06-06T18:00Z", 30)
    # Both entries are free (no busy periods)
    assert result == [
        ("2025-06-06T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T12:00:00Z"),
        ("2025-06-06T13:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T17:00:00Z"),
    ]


def test_working_hours_overlapping_entries():
    """Test overlapping working-hours entries."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-14:00", "12:00-17:00"]}}
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-06T08:00Z", "2025-06-06T18:00Z", 30)
    # Overlapping entries: working 09:00-14:00 and 12:00-17:00
    # Should be treated as continuous working hours 09:00-17:00
    assert result == [("2025-06-06T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T17:00:00Z")]


def test_working_hours_missing_weekday():
    """Test when a weekday has no working hours."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-17:00"]}}
    # Saturday has no entry
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-06T00:00Z", "2025-06-08T00:00Z", 30)
    # Only Friday has working hours
    assert result == [("2025-06-06T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T17:00:00Z")]


def test_working_hours_empty_list_for_weekday():
    """Test when a weekday has an empty list of hours."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-17:00"], "sat": []}}
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-06T00:00Z", "2025-06-08T00:00Z", 30)
    # Saturday has empty list, so no working hours
    assert result == [("2025-06-06T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T17:00:00Z")]


def test_working_hours_all_weekdays():
    """Test with all seven weekdays."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {d: ["09:00-17:00"] for d in FULL_WEEK}}
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-02T00:00Z", "2025-06-09T00:00Z", 30)
    # All days should be working days
    expected_days = [
        ("2025-06-02T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-02T17:00:00Z"),  # Mon
        ("2025-06-03T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-03T17:00:00Z"),  # Tue
        ("2025-06-04T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-04T17:00:00Z"),  # Wed
        ("2025-06-05T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-05T17:00:00Z"),  # Thu
        ("2025-06-06T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T17:00:00Z"),  # Fri
        ("2025-06-07T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-07T17:00:00Z"),  # Sat
        ("2025-06-08T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-08T17:00:00Z"),  # Sun
    ]
    assert result == expected_days


# ============================================================================
# Timestamp parsing
# ============================================================================


def test_timestamp_with_seconds():
    """Test timestamp with seconds (must be :00)."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-17:00"]}}
    result = free_slots(
        [alice], "2025-06-06T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T12:00:00Z", 30
    )
    assert result == [("2025-06-06T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T12:00:00Z")]


def test_timestamp_without_seconds():
    """Test timestamp without seconds."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-17:00"]}}
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-06T09:00Z", "2025-06-06T12:00Z", 30)
    assert result == [("2025-06-06T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T12:00:00Z")]


def test_timestamp_z_offset():
    """Test timestamp with Z (UTC) offset."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-17:00"]}}
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-06T09:00Z", "2025-06-06T12:00Z", 30)
    assert result == [("2025-06-06T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T12:00:00Z")]


def test_timestamp_positive_offset():
    """Test timestamp with positive offset."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-17:00"]}}
    # 2025-06-06T10:00+01:00 is 2025-06-06T09:00Z
    result = free_slots(
        [alice], "2025-06-06T10:00+01:00", "2025-06-06T13:00+01:00", 30
    )
    # Same as 09:00Z to 12:00Z
    assert result == [("2025-06-06T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T12:00:00Z")]


def test_timestamp_negative_offset():
    """Test timestamp with negative offset."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-17:00"]}}
    # 2025-06-06T05:00-04:00 is 2025-06-06T09:00Z
    result = free_slots(
        [alice], "2025-06-06T05:00-04:00", "2025-06-06T08:00-04:00", 30
    )
    # Same as 09:00Z to 12:00Z
    assert result == [("2025-06-06T09:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T12:00:00Z")]


# ============================================================================
# DST transitions
# ============================================================================


def test_dst_spring_forward_ny():
    """Test DST spring forward in America/New_York."""
    # 2025-03-09: 02:00 EST jumps to 03:00 EDT at 07:00Z
    ny = {
        "tz": "America/New_York",
        "hours": {"sun": ["02:00-04:00"]},
    }
    # From 06:00Z to 08:00Z on 2025-03-09
    # 02:00-04:00 EDT is 06:00-08:00Z
    # But 02:00-02:59 EST doesn't exist on this day (spring forward)
    result = free_slots([ny], "2025-03-09T06:00Z", "2025-03-09T08:30Z", 30)
    # 02:30-04:00 EDT (skipped part doesn't work, then 03:00-04:00 EDT works)
    # 03:00-04:00 EDT = 07:00-08:00Z
    assert result == [("2025-03-09T07:00:00Z", "2025-03-09T08:00:00Z")]


def test_dst_fall_back_ny():
    """Test DST fall back in America/New_York."""
    # 2025-11-02: 01:59 EDT goes back to 01:00 EST at 06:00Z
    ny = {
        "tz": "America/New_York",
        "hours": {"sun": ["00:00-03:00"]},
    }
    # 00:00-03:00 EDT (before fall back) covers 04:00-07:00Z
    # Then 00:00-03:00 EST (after fall back) covers 05:00-08:00Z
    # So 00:00-03:00 on fall-back Sunday covers both periods
    result = free_slots([ny], "2025-11-02T04:00Z", "2025-11-02T09:00Z", 30)
    # Working: 04:00-07:00Z (EDT) and 05:00-08:00Z (EST) = 04:00-08:00Z with 05:00-06:00 twice
    # Spec says repeated times are covered both times
    assert result == [("2025-11-02T04:00:00Z", "2025-11-02T08:00:00Z")]


def test_dst_overnight_spring_forward():
    """Test overnight hours crossing spring forward."""
    # From 22:00 Saturday EDT back to 06:00 Sunday EST (but Sunday has spring forward)
    ny = {
        "tz": "America/New_York",
        "hours": {"sat": ["22:00-06:00"]},
    }
    # Saturday 22:00 EDT = Friday 02:00Z
    # Ends on Sunday 06:00 EDT (after spring forward) = Sunday 10:00Z
    result = free_slots([ny], "2025-03-08T23:00Z", "2025-03-09T11:00Z", 30)
    # This covers Sat 22:00 EDT to Sun 06:00 EDT
    # = 02:00Z to 10:00Z Friday/Saturday to Sunday
    assert len(result) >= 1


# ============================================================================
# Window edge cases
# ============================================================================


def test_window_at_midnight():
    """Test window crossing midnight."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-17:00"], "sat": ["10:00-18:00"]}}
    result = free_slots([alice], "2025-06-06T15:00Z", "2025-06-07T12:00Z", 30)
    # Friday 15:00-17:00, Saturday 10:00-12:00
    assert result == [
        ("2025-06-06T15:00:00Z", "2025-06-06T17:00:00Z"),
        ("2025-06-07T10:00:00Z", "2025-06-07T12:00:00Z"),
    ]


def test_window_spans_multiple_days():
    """Test window spanning multiple days."""
    alice = {"tz": "UTC", "hours": {"fri": ["09:00-17:00"], "sat": ["10:00-18:00"]}}
    result = free_slots(

def test_complex_scenario_multiple_zones_busy():
    """Complex scenario with multiple time zones and busy periods."""
    attendees = [
        {
            "tz": "America/New_York",
            "hours": {d: ["09:00-17:00"] for d in WEEK},
            "busy": [["2025-06-02T13:00-04:00", "2025-06-02T14:00-04:00"]],
        },
        {
            "tz": "Europe/Berlin",
            "hours": {d: ["09:00-17:00"] for d in WEEK},
            "busy": [["2025-06-02T15:00+02:00", "2025-06-02T16:00+02:00"]],
        },
        {
            "tz": "Asia/Tokyo",
            "hours": {d: ["09:00-17:00"] for d in WEEK},
        },
    ]
    result = free_slots(attendees, "2025-06-02T00:00Z", "2025-06-03T00:00Z", 60)
    # This requires calculating overlap of all three time zones with busy periods
    assert isinstance(result, list)
    for start, end in result:
        assert start < end
        # Check format
        assert start.endswith("Z")
        assert end.endswith("Z")
